name: Esquivel

prices.note: 5 regular-price sneakers (0 marked-down products excluded). Shopify mens-womens-sneakers collection (esquivelshoes.com redirects to georgeesquivel.com). Classic Weekender Sneaker (men's and women's, leather or suede) $250; Men's Dandy Hi Weekender Sneaker $329.

notes: About: footwear 'made in-house by skilled artisans'; George Esquivel 'made his first pair of shoes in 1994'; CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund finalist 2009. Meta: 'handmade by our team of artisans in our Southern California atelier'. Brand founding year not stated.
Shipping policy: 'complimentary standard shipping on all US orders'. Refund policy: shoe returns within 14 days of receipt, unworn; original shipping non-refundable.
